_brief: Item 13: the Black girl Tal remembered = IMG_9504 (TAL TEL AVIV), a young woman from Ghana, found on frames of every clip in both folders (she is the only one). Her own short video: hook = her best line at 0s ('the good news is I've met you'), then chronological: glad she stepped out -> first person who's spoken to her since she left the house -> people like you keep me positive -> you're the reason I'm out of my house today ... and I met you. NO ZOOMS (LESSONS 80): one static crop for the whole video (it is one locked wide take; the crop only removes empty pavement so faces read). Left out on purpose: her son's illness, the racist assault story, 'what makes you sad' (first words not verifiable by a second model) - nothing negative. Her name: both models hear 'I'm Lebanese' at 236s, which cannot be right for a woman from Ghana, so no name is used.
beats: HOOK: 'the good news is I've met you' / Tal: 'oh wow you're so sweet'
'I'm happy because I stepped out of home to see what's outside, and I'm glad I saw you' (Tal's question cut)
'because you're the first person who's spoken to me since I left the house'
'I stay positive because people like you' (Tal's question cut - the answer stands alone)

PAYOFF, one unbroken run: 'then I guess you're the reason why I'm out of my house today' ... 'the holidays kept me in ... today I just sat in the bus and decided to come here - and I met you'. The camera operator had stepped closer by this point in the take, so this beat is cropped a little LESS (1.2 not 1.4) to keep the two of them the same size on screen as in the beats before - constant framing, not a punch-in
